input: Find a local supper club to join this season

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Supper clubs vary widely — some are recurring dinner parties, some are underground restaurants, some are themed food groups. Knowing exactly what format the user has in mind shapes the entire search.
"Local" is relative — knowing their city or neighbourhood determines where to actually search and which specific clubs are accessible.
Whether they want to go solo, as a couple, or with a group affects which clubs are a good fit (some are singles-oriented, some couples-friendly, some group-focused).
Supper clubs range from free community potlucks to expensive ticketed dinners — budget per event will immediately narrow or widen the options.
Cuisine type, dietary needs, or cultural focus (e.g. Italian, vegan, international rotating) will determine which clubs are actually enjoyable and suitable.
Frequency and scheduling commitment (monthly, weekly, weeknight vs. weekend) affects which clubs are realistically joinable given the user's availability.
The user's primary goal — meeting new people socially, exploring food, learning to cook, or simply having fun dinners — defines what a successful club match looks like.

gold.taskTitle: Find a local supper club to join this season
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify a suitable local supper club to join and attend during the current or upcoming season.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood are you searching in?
questions.description: Pinpoint the user's location to make the search geographically relevant and actionable.

questions.title: What format of supper club are you picturing?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a recurring hosted dinner group, an underground pop-up restaurant experience, a potluck-style community gathering, or something else.

questions.title: Will you be attending solo, as a couple, or with others?
questions.description: Determine the party size and social dynamic so clubs with the right social setup can be targeted.

questions.title: What is your budget per supper club event?
questions.description: Establish a price range per attendance so only financially feasible clubs are considered.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred cuisine style or dietary requirement?
questions.description: Identify food preferences or restrictions (e.g. plant-based, global rotating menu, a specific cuisine) to match the user with a compatible club.

questions.title: How often are you willing to commit to attending events?
questions.description: Understand the user's scheduling availability — weekly, monthly, or ad hoc — to filter clubs by their meeting frequency.

questions.title: What matters most to you — the food itself or the social connection?
questions.description: Determine the user's primary motivation to prioritise clubs that deliver on what they value most, whether culinary quality or community building.
